title: Persistence Spheres: a Bi-continuous Linear Representation of Measures for Partial Optimal Transport
summary: We improve and extend persistence spheres, introduced in~\cite{pegoraro2025persistence}. Persistence spheres map an integrable measure $μ$ on the upper half-plane, including persistence diagrams (PDs) as counting measures, to a function $S(μ)\in C(\mathbb{S}^2)$, and the map is stable with respect to 1-Wasserstein partial transport distance $\mathrm{POT}_1$. Moreover, to the best of our knowledge, persistence spheres are the first explicit representation used in topological machine learning for which continuity of the inverse on the image is established at every compactly supported target.…
